question: A city map has 500 fire stations and 1,000,000 street corners. For every corner you need the fewest blocks to the nearest station. What is the best plan?
options: One BFS that starts with all 500 stations in the queue
One BFS from each station, keeping the smallest distance
One BFS from each corner until it reaches a station
explanation: Starting all stations at distance 0 lets one BFS grow from all of them together; each corner is first reached from its nearest station. That is one pass, O(V + E), instead of 500 or a million searches.
